what: Set the inner photo cell to (100 + 100/intensity)% height. Until the cell enters from below the screen and leaves upward, the inside moves from −v/2 to v/2, so the photo flows slowly inside the cell (v = Box height / intensity × min(window width, 1440) / 1440, default intensity 4). Only on wide screens (1025px and up)

duration.Scroll: While the cell passes across the screen

options.force: Strength — the larger, the less it flows, default 4 (1/4 of the cell height)
options.min: Minimum window width (px) to turn on, default 1025 — 0 enables it on phones too
options.travel: Flow distance (px) — if given, instead of intensity the inside moves the translate property from −travel/2 → +travel/2 (example A 200). With vw attached like ‹30vw›, it is a share of window width (example B 30vw)
options.from-scale: With travel — scale on entering, 1 on leaving (scale property), default 1 (1.05 in the original)
options.range: With travel — cover (default, from the cell entering at the bottom of the screen until it exits at the top)
options.shift: Flow share (%) — if given, instead of strength the inner part is pushed from −shift% to +shift% of its own height (gsap yPercent, from the cell entering at the bottom of the screen until it leaves at the top). The inner part is top-aligned at grow% height · corp-brand 10
options.grow: Used with shift — inner height (%), default 110
options.scale: with shift — instead of growing the inside (grow), it stays at its own size and is scaled by this ratio (brand 1 + push×.01, e.g. 1.04)
options.frame: Together with shift — the cell itself also pushes from −frame% to +frame% of its own height (Brand 4). If 0, the cell stays still
options.from: Start position (%), default -shift — if given, it pushes even when shift is 0 (end position = shift). The inner is aligned to the top at grow%, so to make a photo aligned to the bottom come down until it aligns to the top, use from: −(grow−100)/grow×100 · shift: 0 (brand: grow 140 · from −28.571 · shift 0).

note: Wraps the cell’s children in one inner plate (restores them when removed). The cell needs a height (aspect-ratio etc.). The travel type uses the translate·scale properties, not transform, like STUDIO view(), and sets the inner larger by the travel amount
